name: io.github.olo-dot-io/Uni-CLI
description: Operation-first Agent-Computer Interface for real software, with a static catalog of 326 adapter sites, 980 declarative YAML adapters, and 1830 registered adapter commands. Native CLI also loads fixed core and host-discovered commands; MCP default, deferred, and expanded profiles project adapter commands. Structured errors can name the owning adapter, and bounded repair verification reruns the exact original command without hidden mutation.
